title: To designate the medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Ann Arbor, Michigan, as the Lieutenant Colonel Charles S. Kettles Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center.
official_summary: This bill designates the medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Ann Arbor, Michigan, as the Lieutenant Colonel Charles S. Kettles Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center or the Lieutenant Colonel Charles S. Kettles VA Medical Center.

summary.headline: Names the VA medical center in Ann Arbor, Michigan, after Lieutenant Colonel Charles S. Kettles.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the Department of Veterans Affairs medical center in Ann Arbor, Michigan. The facility will be called the Lieutenant Colonel Charles S. Kettles Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center. It can also be called the Lieutenant Colonel Charles S. Kettles VA Medical Center. The law changes only the name and does not change services or benefits.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021.
